description: Initial policies for an autonomous healthcare insurance claims agent.

policies.name: approved_resource_boundary
policies.description: The agent should not access resources outside its approved working area.

policies.name: approved_data_destinations
policies.description: The agent should not access or transfer data to unapproved external destinations.

policies.name: sensitive_resource_access
policies.description: Access to sensitive resources should be reviewed against the agent's authorized purpose.
